facts.text: Deborah mentions that her yoga pals have been her second family and have supported her through difficult times.

evidence.quote: Relationships with family and friends are so vital. My yoga pals have been my second family - we've held each other up through a lot.

facts.text: Deborah recalls that her mother was a significant source of motivation and often attended her yoga classes.

evidence.quote: My mum was my biggest fan and source of motivation. She'd often come to my classes with me.

facts.text: Jolene states that she taught herself how to play video games, but her father was supportive and her mother played games with her.

evidence.quote: I taught myself, but my dad was always supportive and my mom would play games with me.

facts.text: Jolene mentions that one of her favorite games to play with her mother was 'Monster Hunter: World'.

evidence.quote: One of my favorites was 'Monster Hunter: World'. The immersive story and open-world gaming are amazing!
